    3D population density map Nigeria

    224.1M people · 246 per km²

    Nigeria in numbers

    Nigeria has 224,135,234 people on about 912,000 km² of land, roughly 246 per km². They live in 637,762 populated hexagons; the densest, in Kumshe, Bama, Borno State, holds 34,023 people, about 46,000 per km².
